observation: Fresh main binds granted actors, warrants and needs using canonical RCL runtime semantics, but the durable receipt boundary still accepts arbitrary nonempty strings for actor, subject, capability and target. Canonical RCL source cannot emit many of those strings: subjects and causes are IDENT tokens, while needs/warrant capabilities and targets are parser paths made from dot-separated IDENT tokens.

xingxuling/RCL src/parser.mjs: parsePath is one or more dot-separated IDENT tokens; subject names are IDENT; warrant capability and target use parsePath
xingxuling/RCL src/runtime.mjs: Taowind Code passes materialized RCL source into runReality, so the source lexer/parser is the relevant emission boundary
